data.name: Involved
data.detailed_description:
Living Ecosystem & Day/Night Cycle

Reactive wildlife, dynamic weather, and nocturnal predators: every night is a challenge. Hunt game by day, defend your camp by night, and survive seasonal events that shake up the gameplay.

Free Building & Deep Crafting

From your first stone tools to fortified strongholds: recipes to unlock, a modular piece-by-piece building system, and rare blueprints to discover across the world.

Multiplayer Survival

Team up with up to 64 players to face an unforgiving wilderness. Build shelters, share resources, and defend your territory together — or betray your allies when hunger strikes.

Deep Roleplay Experience

Forge your own story in a world where every choice matters. Create a unique character, join factions, establish trade routes, or build your own base from scratch.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64 Bits
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2,5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 Go of VRAM or more
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64 Bits
  • Processor: Processor Intel or AMD multi-core, 3,5 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 6 Go of VRAM or more
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
